name: Exp_ColorJVariation
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJVariation custom indicator, which is a JMA-smoothed variation oscillator. It opens buy positions when the indicator value rises consecutively (Value[0]>Value[1]>Value[2] pattern) and sell positions when it falls consecutively, with separate permissions for entry and exit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJVariation自定义指标进行交易，该指标是经过JMA平滑的变异震荡器。当指标值连续上升时开多仓，连续下降时开空仓，入场和出场分别有独立的权限控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorJVariation指标的动量变化判断趋势方向。入场条件：当Value[1]<Value[2]（前期下降）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前回升）时触发买入信号，表明下跌动量减弱、趋势可能反转向上；当Value[1]>Value[2]（前期上升）且Value[0]<Value[1]（当前回落）时触发卖出信号，表明上涨动量减弱。出场条件：买入信号同时触发空仓平仓，卖出信号同时触发多仓平仓，实现了趋势反转时的自动换仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算。资金管理采用固定止损和止盈点数（StopLoss=1000, TakeProfit=2000），风险回报比为1:2。策略使用IsNewBar机制仅在NewBar时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum changes in the ColorJVariation indicator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when Value[1]<Value[2] (prior decline) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current recovery), indicating weakening downward momentum and potential upward reversal; a sell signal triggers when Value[1]>Value[2] (prior rise) and Value[0]<Value[1] (current decline), indicating weakening upward momentum. Exit conditions: the buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of short positions, and the sell signal triggers closing of long positions, enabling automatic position reversal on trend changes. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share percentage. Money management uses fixed stop loss and take profit in points (StopLoss=1000, TakeProfit=2000), yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to calculate signals only on new bar formation, avoiding redundant per-tick calculations.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Funding ratio or fixed lots; negative = lots, positive = deposit ratio

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 采用JMA平滑的自定义指标，信号质量优于普通移动平均
入场和出场权限独立控制，灵活性高，可单独禁用买入或卖出
使用IsNewBar机制避免逐tick重复计算，计算效率高
风险回报比为1:2，止盈大于止损，长期期望值为正
信号逻辑基于动量反转，能捕捉趋势转折点
pros_en: Uses JMA-smoothed custom indicator for higher signal quality compared to simple moving averages
Independent entry and exit permission controls offer high flexibility to disable buy or sell independently
Employs IsNewBar mechanism to avoid redundant per-tick calculations, improving efficiency
Risk-reward ratio of 1:2 with take profit exceeding stop loss, positive long-term expectancy
Signal logic based on momentum reversal can capture trend turning points
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时可能导致不利成交
没有持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致仓位过大
依赖自定义指标ColorJVariation，指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损1000点较大，单笔亏损可能较重
SignalBar=1使用已完成K线信号，但SignalBar=0时每tick都重新计算，逻辑不一致
cons_en: Lacks spread filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills during high-spread conditions
No position check before opening, risking duplicate positions and oversized exposure
Depends on custom ColorJVariation indicator file; EA fails if indicator is missing
Stop loss of 1000 points is relatively large, potentially causing significant single-trade losses
SignalBar=0 triggers per-tick recalculation while SignalBar=1 uses new-bar logic, creating inconsistent behavior
improvements: 增加点差过滤和持仓数量检查，避免高滑点和重复开仓
增加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定部分利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and open position count check to avoid high-slippage entries and duplicate positions
Add trailing stop functionality to lock in partial profits during extended trends

risk_points: 无持仓检查可能导致重复开仓，仓位失控
止损1000点较大，在杠杆账户中可能造成重大亏损
依赖外部指标文件，指标缺失时无交易信号但也不会报错退出
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate position opening and uncontrolled exposure
Stop loss of 1000 points is large and can cause significant losses on leveraged accounts
Depends on external indicator file; missing indicator yields no signals but EA does not safely exit
